fields.label: Method
fields.description: Microwave, Machine or Both (set from the values entered).

fields.label: Fresh Weight (g)
fields.description: What the scale shows for the fresh sample, dish included when a dish weight is given.

fields.label: Dish Weight (g)
fields.description: Optional tare. Taken off both the fresh and the dry weight.

fields.label: Dry Weight (g)
fields.description: After microwave drying, dish included when a dish weight is given.

fields.label: Microwave Dry Matter %
fields.description: (dry - dish) / (fresh - dish) x 100, worked out by the app.

fields.label: Machine Dry Matter %
fields.description: Read straight off the dry matter meter.

fields.label: Dry Matter %
fields.description: The average of the two methods when both were used, else the one that was.
